companyFieldUpdates.description: Waste Resource Management, also known as WRM, owns and operates liquid-waste collection, treatment, recycling and disposal infrastructure across multiple U.S. markets. Ridgewood Infrastructure acquired the platform in late 2023 and continues to classify it as an unrealized investment. NGP Energy Technology Partners and North Sky Capital were predecessor investors that exited when Ridgewood acquired the company. Exact current and former percentage stakes, entry dates and acquisition vehicles are not publicly disclosed.
